workflow.description: Structured medication reconciliation from synthetic FHIR-like records

task.name: medication_reconciliation
task.description: Compare MedicationRequest and MedicationStatement records. Identify matched medications, medications present only in one source, discrepancies requiring human review, and potential duplicates. Do NOT recommend treatment, change doses, diagnose disease, or provide clinical decisions.

input_fields.history: list of free-text patient medication history strings
input_fields.requests: list of MedicationRequest objects with keys: medication, dose
input_fields.statements: list of MedicationStatement objects with keys: medication, dose

output_fields.matched: list of medication names present in both requests and statements
output_fields.only_in_request: list of medication names present only in requests
output_fields.only_in_statement: list of medication names present only in statements
output_fields.discrepancies: list of discrepancy descriptions requiring human review
output_fields.human_review_required: boolean indicating whether any discrepancies were found
